title: Remembering Professor Guoyan Zhao
summary_en: Professor Guoyan Zhao, an associate professor in the Departments of Genetics and Neurology at the WashU School of Medicine, died on May 15, 2026. She was 54 years old. Zhao is remembered by her colleagues as a brilliant, dedicated scientist as well as a deeply caring mentor and friend.
author: Coby Rinke

title: WashU- and Vanderbilt-commissioned report on the humanities comes under fire
summary_en: The report has generated significant pushback from humanities professors, the WashU chapter of the American Association of University Professors (AAUP), and the Director of the WashU Center for the Humanities, among others.
author: Lexi Lawsky
title_cn: WashU- and Vanderbilt-commissioned report on the humanities comes under fire

title: New School of Public Health receives largest donation in WashU history
summary_en: WashU’s new School of Public Health received $200 million, the largest donation in the history of the University, from the Bursky Family Foundation in May. The school has been renamed the Andrew M. and Jane M. Bursky School of Public Health after foundation founders and alumni Andrew Bursky, outgoing chair of the WashU Board of Trustees, and his wife, Jane Bursky.
author: Coby Rinke, Tanvi Gorre
title_cn: New School of Public Health receives largest donation in WashU history
